sec: sec:A007: Prevent IP violations / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:A007: Prevent IP violations / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Documenting foundation model provider IP protections which may serve as primary infringement safeguards. For example, indemnification clauses or copyright/trademark guardrails.
